name: Fleet board
description: A task board every desk in the room shares, built from one owned log per desk and a local fold. No coordinator: concurrent claims resolve identically everywhere, including while a desk is dark.

tools.name: board_create
tools.description: Add a task to the fleet board, visible on every desk in the room.

by.description: Who is adding it — a teammate's name

tools.name: board_claim
tools.description: Claim a task so no other desk works it. Two desks claiming at once both write; the whole room agrees on the same winner and the loser is told.

by.description: Who is claiming — a teammate's name

ttlMinutes.description: How long the claim holds. Default 30.

tools.name: board_progress
tools.description: Say how a claimed task is going, and renew the claim by the same act. Only the desk holding the claim can write it.

note.description: Where the work has got to

ttlMinutes.description: How much longer the claim holds. Default 30.

tools.name: board_release
tools.description: Give a claim back without finishing the task. The way out of board_claim that does not require waiting for it to expire.

tools.name: board_reclaim
tools.description: Take over a claim that has expired. Accepted only if the log says it expired — no desk's clock decides.

tools.name: board_complete
tools.description: Mark a task done on the fleet board. A claimed task is completed by the desk holding it.

tools.name: board_list
tools.description: Every task on the fleet board, with a line saying how much of the room this desk can actually see.

digest.description: sha256 of the ordered op ids folded

cursorDigest.description: sha256 of the cursor set folded from. Without it a digest cannot be judged: two desks always differ while one is behind.
